ITEM 1 | Red plate roughly 26 cm across used as reference; a single round apple, glossy red-yellow skin with green patches, about 7.5 cm diameter and 7 cm tall, whole and uncut, resting at the left-center of the plate | 180
ITEM 2 | Cherry tomatoes, glossy bright red, smooth taut skins, about 2.5 to 3 cm each, whole, clustered around the upper right and right edge of the plate, roughly 20 pieces | 250
ITEM 3 | Red seedless grapes, deep burgundy to dark purple with a few lighter green-yellow ones, smooth glossy skins, about 1.5 to 2 cm each, in a loose cluster across the upper left-center, roughly 25 grapes | 120
ITEM 4 | Carrot pieces, bright orange, matte to slightly glossy surface, raw and crisp-looking, cut into thick diagonal coin and stick shapes about 4 to 6 cm long and 1 to 1.5 cm thick, piled in the center-right of the plate, roughly 20 pieces | 150
ITEM 5 | Whole almonds, tan to light brown, dry matte papery skins with slight ridges, each about 2 to 2.5 cm long, scattered in a loose heap at the lower left of the plate, roughly 25 nuts | 50
